scope_note: Generated navigation/evidence inventory, not architecture authority or behavioral acceptance. First-party tracked/nonignored paths were filtered; no claim that every path was individually read or tested.
exclusions: Generated/vendor/build path components: node_modules, .next, build, .dart_tool, dist, .wrangler, coverage, ephemeral
Documentation/evidence snapshots excluded from the 6422 code/config/test path count; selected authoritative and phase documents inspected separately
Environment values, credentials, signing material and private customer/business documents not copied into this inventory
Reference donor paths counted separately below

inspection_depth.all_roots: Manifest/classification/ownership inventory for 17 app/donor roots, 10 service runtime manifests and 55 package roots; not full line-by-line review.
deeper_paths: Existing customer navigation, native seller feed, checkout state/attempt and payment screen
Merchant channel model, progressive KYC/settings, listing moderation and category commission scope
Store Ops and Delivery source history, token/API assumptions and task/custody gaps
Canonical identity, tenant transaction and permission guard
Inventory locations, reservation/commit/adjustment and latest order creation
Payment guard, capture/refund/webhook and COD collection/remittance writers
Manual release workflows, workspace and sanitized project mapping shape
not_executed: Owned DB or hosted schema/RLS tests
Production deployment or cloud configuration changes
